limitations: This assessment covers one representative modification workflow, including executing the change. It does not measure understanding, diagnosis or execution as separate task types.
Task effort measures these tasks under the recorded agent settings; it is not a universal measure of human cognitive burden.
Tokens count solver model inputs and outputs, including cached input. Missing usage is unavailable, never zero. Examiner and judge overhead is separate.
Empirical ranges describe repeated observations, not statistical confidence intervals. Failed or unrun tasks do not establish an improvement.
Task links identify assessed capabilities only; they do not change module behavior verification badges.
Task prompts, hidden inputs, judging rubrics, source excerpts, raw traces and local paths are omitted from this public report.
Cached input is a subset of input, not an extra charge in token totals.
Missing usage remains missing; observed totals may be a lower bound.
Coordinator conversation, preparation, report generation and publication costs are excluded.
Cost comparisons use solver tokens only; experiment totals separately include examiner and controller/author overhead.

limitations: Static observations support review; they do not prove readability or universal semantic equivalence.
这是 core 范围压缩，不是保留原仓库全部功能；相对全仓库的压缩率包括删除范围外功能。
任务成本只覆盖一个 modify 任务及其开发/隐藏变体，不代表所有语言、任务或人的认知负担。
每侧最多 3 次重复，报告中位数及最小/最大值；经验范围不是统计置信区间。
隐藏任务仅在开发成本门槛通过后运行；未运行不等于通过，也不能记为零成本优势。
输入 tokens 已包含缓存输入，输出 tokens 已包含推理输出；不重复相加，且 tokens 不等于美元成本。
实验成本包括重写、Controller、出题、解题；不包括协调会话、准备知识包、预检、报告制作与发布。
复用经原始文件哈希核对的语义知识和验收资源；重新实现代码并重新运行原版基线，不复用旧候选代码或通过记录。
源代码隔离依赖协作规则与独立工作目录，不是独立操作系统安全边界。
选定验收通过不证明对所有可能输入都语义等价。原始测试保留供审计，全量测试也会触及明确排除的功能。
